brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@buildthis.bisks.net could you make a "social suaveness" quiz that uses the above 38 questions relating to empathy? a high result means:

“You're good at reading people, taking their perspective, navigating social situations, and adjusting your behavior accordingly.”

i believe in you, suave bot!

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@shimmermathlabs.com: new compliment unlocked:
"not bad, entirely contextually appropriate"

i'm amazingly socially suave.
  [quoting @heartpunk.com: k, thoughts:

1. not bad, entirely contextually appropriate
2. i am not that particular sort of functional programming pervert even if i was incidentally in p much exactly the same lisp scene as tunney
3. i would prefer dependent types, personally
4. this shit is still cool tech]
@shimmermathlabs.com: here are 38 true/false questions for measuring empathy:
1. I like poetry.
2. Unexpected changes to my routine bother me.
3. I’d enjoy working as a foreign correspondent.
4. I sometimes enjoy breaking rules.
5. I talk very little except with people I know well.
@shimmermathlabs.com: 6. I consider how my friends will react before I act.
7. I liked *Alice in Wonderland*.
8. I become irritable sometimes without knowing why.
9. I enjoy playful, joking company.
10. I’d enjoy being a journalist.
11. I don’t especially care whether people like me.
12. I’ve tried writing poetry.
@shimmermathlabs.com: 13. I naturally tend to influence people.
14. I find it hard to sit still and relax.
15. I prefer showers to baths.
16. I sometimes pretend to be ill to avoid doing something.
17. People nowadays don’t have enough sense of shame.
18. I enjoy speaking in front of groups.
@shimmermathlabs.com: 19. My arguments with people are usually about matters of principle.
20. I’m usually the leader in a group.
21. I fear deep water.
22. I sometimes feel unusually happy or excited for no obvious reason.
23. I mix easily with other people socially.
@shimmermathlabs.com: 24. I like keeping people guessing about what I’m going to do.
25. Showing off is sometimes appropriate.
26. I consider other people’s feelings before acting.
27. My parents were very strict.
28. I’d enjoy belonging to a singing club.
29. Sarcastic and clever people sometimes make me uncomfortable.
@shimmermathlabs.com: 30. I tend to pursue what I want regardless of what others think.
31. I disliked school.
32. Everything ought to have a proper place.
33. I have thoughts that seem too bad to talk about.
34. People generally aren’t serious enough.
35. I need problems to have clear, definite answers.
@shimmermathlabs.com: 36. Other people often misunderstand why I do things the way I do.
37. Trying to change the American way of life is foolish.
38. I actively take part in entertainment at parties.

Reverse-coded: 2, 5, 8, 11, 14, 17, 21, 24, 27, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37.
note: built suave — all 38 of your empathy questions, true/false, reverse-scored exactly as specified. score high enough and you get your own line back: good at reading people, adjusting on the fly.
